reason: The plugin is a DSH Web theme/appearance plugin whose primary purpose is interface theming and visual style customization. It overrides DSH client theme tokens, injects global CSS, and adds UI preference toggles (including watermark behavior) via localStorage. It is primarily a user-facing cosmetic/UX plugin with no evidence of external integrations, network calls, or data-processing side effects.

capabilities: theme token override in DSH client runtime

reasons.code: README describes theme.overrideTokens usage to replace default color tokens for light/dark themes
README describes styles.insert injecting global stylesheet overrides (fonts, border radius, accent colors, hover states, buttons, tables, etc.)
README describes watermark UI with anti-translation attributes and placement/opacity controls
README and package metadata show a client-side DSH plugin entry (exports ./client, bundle patch/injection config), confirming browser-side execution only

capabilities: theme token override in DSH client runtime
